Stats

WYR_PaintingShadow
The Judge is a named Shadow creature found in The Wyrmway in Act Three.

Involvement

The Judge prevents the party from passing judgement and so must be dealt with. It is immune to all forms of damage so alternative methods must be used.

Known ways to remove the judge:

  •  Banishment
  •  Control Undead
  •  Exhort the Risen
  •  Polymorph
  •  Power Word Kill (The Dark Urge exclusive)
  •  Remove Curse
  •  Turn Undead
  • Methods that Control Undead
    •  Darkness (drive the judge out with blindness field avoidance behavior)
    •  Displace (teleport the judge anywhere outside the circle)
    •  Hunger of Hadar,  Moonbeam, and  Spirit Guardians (push the judge out with the damage field avoidance behavior)
